name: Post hoc Arkansas source-rounding diagnostic

rounding.interval: closed feasible rounding rectangle; no measurement-error distribution claimed

policy: yield-first only; original policies and main comparisons unchanged

fixed_query.tested_sets: original recorded yield-first sets, independently validated against original source yield ranking
fixed_query.worst_corner: tested yield/HR lower endpoints; untested upper endpoints
fixed_query.best_corner: tested yield/HR upper endpoints; untested lower endpoints
fixed_query.proof: For fixed Q, increasing a tested value cannot increase regret or relative regret or reduce oracle top-k membership in Q; increasing an untested value has the reverse order. Hence corners attain marginal metric extrema.
fixed_query.scope: Sharp fixed-query extrema pointwise per budget; different budgets use different corners. Envelope grid crossings summarize possible/guaranteed threshold positions, not one common attained curve.

joint_perturbation.distribution: independent uniform offsets inside each candidate source-rounding rectangle; a transparent sensitivity design, not estimated measurement uncertainty
joint_perturbation.interpretation: Scenario summaries only; no guaranteed joint bounds, confidence intervals or p-values.

deterministic_joint_scenarios.global_corners: all four combinations of yield offset +/-0.5 and HR offset +/-0.5
deterministic_joint_scenarios.budget_targeted_corners: both fixed-query best and worst corner realizations for every six-budget queried set, then recompute yield-first queries using that same realized yield and score with the same yield/HR
deterministic_joint_scenarios.interpretation: Predeclared symmetric feasible stress scenarios, not exhaustive joint bounds

aggregation: equal weight per original pool; subset counts fixed; random scenarios do not create independent field trials
uruguay_reference: fixed original yield-first values in188 temporal pools; no Uruguay precision perturbation or cross-program absolute-unit comparison

independent_checks.fixed_corner: scalar Python/math.fsum implementation for every pool x budget x corner
independent_checks.deterministic_scenarios: scalar implementation for all pools x scenarios x budgets
independent_checks.synthetic: small exhaustive product-rectangle vertices to validate fixed-query monotonic extrema
